rationale: Two newly-added regression tests use a '<= 1' assertion instead of '== 1', meaning both double-wrap tests pass vacuously when the error message contains zero occurrences of 'work_item_json'. Three pre-existing gaps (non-dict JSON root, non-dict fields value, invalid field key path) were deferred as out of scope for this change. No spec was supplied; acceptance: n/a. 2 dismissed as noise.

findings.title: Lax double-wrap assertion passes vacuously
findings.problem: assert msg.count('work_item_json') <= 1 passes when the count is 0, making the double-wrap regression test for CreateWorkItemTool trivially green even if the actionable message is absent.
findings.impact: The primary correctness claim of this fix — that the error message is not double-wrapped and includes 'work_item_json' — is unverifiable; a regression silently passes the suite.
findings.recommendation: Change '<= 1' to '== 1' so the test enforces exactly one occurrence, matching the intent of the double-wrap guard.

findings.title: Lax update double-wrap assertion passes vacuously
findings.problem: assert msg.count('work_item_json') <= 1 on UpdateWorkItemTool's malformed-JSON test has the same laxness: 0 occurrences satisfies the condition.
findings.impact: The update-path double-wrap regression can silently regress; the same fix that breaks CreateWorkItemTool would also break UpdateWorkItemTool undetected.
findings.recommendation: Change '<= 1' to '== 1' on the UpdateWorkItemTool assertion.
